fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: A claw strike that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hundredth Repetition
fusions.desc: A tail sweep that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered by Rote
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 4% higher at all times.
